metadata.question: In November 2021, did Seattle experience less than 20cm of rainfall?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Primary: ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR; band: total_precipitation_sum (m). Filter 2021-11-01 to 2021-12-01; region: 20 km buffer around Seattle city center.
- Fallback: CHIRPS Daily (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY), sum over the month to get total precipitation (mm).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Not applicable; reanalysis and gridded precipitation products have no cloud masking.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection size is 0 for both datasets: C1.
- If valid pixel count after processing is 0: C2.
- If mean is null/NaN or out-of-physical-range (<0 or >3000 mm): C3.
- Else compare mean precipitation to 200 mm (20 cm) to decide A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  const eeGet = (obj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate((v, err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(v))));

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2021-11-01';
    const end = '2021-12-01';
    const seattlePt = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]);
    const geom = seattlePt.buffer(20000).bounds();

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR';
    let bandName = 'ppt_mm';
    let image = null;

    const eraCol = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select('total_precipitation_sum');
    const eraCount = await eeGet(eraCol.size());

    if (eraCount > 0) {
      // Convert meters to mm
      image = ee.Image(eraCol.first()).multiply(1000).rename(bandName);
    } else {
      // Fallback: CHIRPS daily summed to monthly (already in mm)
      dataset = 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY (monthly sum)';
      const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select('precipitation');
      const chirpsCount = await eeGet(chirps.size());
      if (chirpsCount === 0) {
        console.log('ERA5-Land Monthly images: 0');
        console.log('CHIRPS Daily images: 0');
        console.log('Reason: No images found in date/location.');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
        return;
      } else {
        image = chirps.sum().rename(bandName);
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing: Pixel count to detect C2
    const countDict = await eeGet(
      image.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 5000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      })
    );
    const validCount = countDict ? countDict[bandName] : 0;
    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset Used: ${dataset}`);
      console.log(`Valid Pixels: 0`);
      console.log('Reason: All pixels are null/masked.');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: Regional mean precipitation (mm)
    const meanDict = await eeGet(
      image.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 5000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      })
    );
    const meanMM = meanDict ? meanDict[bandName] : null;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if (meanMM === null || isNaN(meanMM) || meanMM < 0 || meanMM > 3000) {
      console.log(`Dataset Used: ${dataset}`);
      console.log(`Images Found: ${eraCount} (primary); fallback if 0`);
      console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${validCount}`);
      console.log(`Monthly Precip (mm): ${meanMM}`);
      console.log('Reason: Calculation invalid (null/NaN/out-of-range).');
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is `None`, `NaN`, or invalid).');
      return;
    }

    const meanCM = meanMM / 10.0;
    console.log(`Area: Seattle (20 km buffer)`);
    console.log(`Dataset Used: ${dataset}`);
    console.log(`Images Found (primary ERA5-Land): ${eraCount}`);
    console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${validCount}`);
    console.log(`Monthly Precip (mm): ${meanMM.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Monthly Precip (cm): ${meanCM.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Threshold (mm): 200.0`);

    if (meanMM < 200.0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
